FN-EJLW799-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 3
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 3 as reported would, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, decrease sales tax receipts
to the Education Trust Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of gross
receipts derived from the sale of certain retail fish or other seafood sales exempted by the bill.
This bill would also decrease sales tax receipts to county and municipal funds of any local
governments that adopt an exemption pursuent to the bill by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the amount of gross receipts derived from such sale and the applicable local tax rate.
